• Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned (blog.tamarack.example).
• The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks (companion piece, insights.tamarack.example).
• Net takeaway: automation ROI is real but hinges on budgeting realistic integration timelines.
